name: village_forage
desc: walk to a known village in daylight and take food: hay bales (1 bale = 9 wheat; at least one bale is always left standing), ONLY ripe crops (replanted), then bake bread (3 wheat each). Never touches villagers or their chests. Needs daylight for the walk there; refuses honestly when dusk is too close. Result lists what you got

cooldown.text: the village gave nothing (no spare hay bale, no ripe crop)
cooldown.hint: come back after a day when the crops have grown; the farm_plot at home is the lasting source
